text:
Partial completion: `verify_tls_server` shipped at pkix-chain/src/lib.rs (composes verify_chain + pkix_identity::verify_dns_name; pre-parsed `&ServerName<'_>` identity per (D1); generic `<P: Profile>` per (C2); baked DefaultVerifier per (C2); explicit `&impl RevocationChecker` per (B1)). Six integration tests pass: positive match, case-insensitive target, hostname mismatch, missing SAN, order-of-checks (path before identity), BasicTlsProfile generic-wiring smoke test. New error variant `Error::Identity(IdentityError)` added with Display/From impls; re-exports added for `ServerName`, `MailboxName`, `IdentityError`. Generated fixture set in pkix-chain/tests/fixtures/ via pyca/cryptography (root + leaf-with-SAN + leaf-without-SAN, P-256).

`verify_tls_client` deferred to child PKIX-fmtv.11.2.1 (human-labeled). PKIX-fmtv.7's (D1) constrains identity args to pre-parsed ServerName/MailboxName but does not pin down which `verify_tls_client` should accept; TLS client auth identity types are intrinsically more varied than server identity. Filed as a separate shape-clarification bead and added as a blocking dep on this one.
